verdict.rationale: The evidence describes Skills as packaged instructions/resources Claude loads when relevant, and related Claude Code features like background 'Agent view' sessions and 'Agent teams' for coordinating instances, but none of this describes setting up autonomous, unattended automations (e.g., scheduled or event-triggered background runs) — it only covers monitoring already-running sessions or invoking skills within an active conversation. Missing for 10: evidence of scheduling/triggers for unattended runs, evidence of automations executing without a user-initiated session, and any hands-on confirmation of autonomous background operation.
